domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 构件在给定循环作用下达到疲劳失效所需的循环次数或时间。
usage_overview: 在混凝土车致疲劳损伤分析中，用作损伤演化历程的归一化尺度，以达到疲劳终止状态的加载次数为参照，表示循环加载过程中所处的疲劳阶段。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P084.title: The effect of fastener clip fatigue for high-speed railway on vehicle-track dynamic interaction: Numerical analysis and probabilistic evaluation
P084.authors: Z Li, H Liu, W Wang, L Xu
P084.label: Li等（2024）

complete_examples.text: The “rain flow” counting method is adopted to describe the stress cycles of the hazard area of the clips, and the S-N curve is used to predict the fatigue life of the clips.

Ke r, x, Ke r, y, Ke r, z, Ke r,θ the stiffness matrices for the rail (longitudinal, lateral, vertical, and rotation around the x-axis) Sa the fatigue stress amplitude of 60Si2MnA steel; Smax, Smin the maximum and minimum cyclic stress amplitude Sc the von Mises stress of the hazardous area of the clip ΔXf the relative displacement between the rail and the track slab Sa, R = −1 the modified fatigue stress Su the tensile strength of fastener clips Sm the mean value of fatigue stress Lr the horizontal distance between the clip and the center of mass of the rail cross-section KLE Karhunen–Lo`eve Expansion S-N the relationship between the stress and the fatigue life CB(u, u′) the correlation structure of the random field CDF cumulative density function PDF probability density function Std standard deviation FE finite element Z. Li et al. concluded that fatigue or even fracture of the clips may threaten the safety of train operation, which is reflected in the decrease of fastener tightening force provided by the elastic clips, leading to the inability of the fastener to provide a stable connection between the rail and the track slab and the resultant dynamic instability of the system.
